source_review.notes: Checked official NASA records/pages for the TRA Best Practices Guide, Systems Engineering Handbook technology-assessment appendix and TRL material, Earth Science hardware/software criteria, Software Engineering Handbook STRL guidance, and JPL TRA guideline; official GAO representation for GAO-20-48G; current DOE TRA document and directives index; and official ISO 16290 metadata. All NASA, DOE, and JPL/NTRS resources returned HTTP 200. GAO and ISO returned HTTP 403 to the command-line client after their current official representations had been inspected through the web retrieval path. The chapter treats TRL as application-specific demonstrated maturity, retains weakest-link and integration evidence, and separates current level from advancement difficulty and adjacent readiness constructs.

symbolic_recomputation.notes: The chapter consistently labels readiness as an evidence judgment under policy and application context, not a proven theorem or automatic scoring algorithm.
